worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.summary: Spins the pointed part of its body into a drill and bores straight along the current aim: it first tears away whatever guard stands in the way, then slams the full weight of the hit in and shoves the target back. Through mode drills past several targets; it stops at the real contact when it hits a wall, spends its charge, or the target will not budge (a Boss or hard collision), without breaking blocks or clipping through.
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.use.0: Bore straight through a target that raised a guard
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.use.1: Pierce several enemies lined up on one line
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.use.2: Finish whoever stands in front with high contact damage
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.description: The bore deals about %1$s contact damage.
Drills %1$s blocks along the aimed direction at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s-block drill radius; it stops when it hits a wall or spends its whole charge.

Tears up to %1$s guard layers off a target (Protect, Detect, Wide Guard and Harden all share this guard mechanism) and shoves it %2$s blocks; through mode pierces up to %3$s targets, focus mode stops at the first.
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.through.on: Through mode: the drill pierces up to %1$s targets, reach x1.15 and speed x1.1, at the cost of x0.9 power per hit, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown, for drilling a whole line.
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.through.off: Focus mode: stops at the first target with x1.2 power, a faster wind-up and a shorter cooldown, for boring through one hard target.
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.growth.0: From level %1$s the drill rises to %2$s power and tears %3$s guard layers.
worldcombat.skill.hyperdrill.growth.1: From level %1$s the drill rises again to %2$s power and the charge grows to %3$s blocks.
On: the drill pierces up to 3 targets, reach x1.15 and speed x1.1, at the cost of x0.9 power per hit, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown, for drilling a whole line. Off (focus): stops at the first target with x1.2 power, a faster wind-up and a shorter cooldown, for boring through one hard target.
The companion only drills toward a target within this distance; larger values let it commit from further out, and make it easier to be shaken off mid-drill.
On: a target carrying a guard ranks much higher, so the companion tears it before the shared order. Off: ordinary heavy-attack ordering.
